dmca.title: Copyright & DMCA
dmca.intro: Every chart on UntitledCharts is uploaded by a player, and charts usually come with the song's audio and artwork. Sometimes that means something gets uploaded that the rights holder never agreed to. If that's your work, tell us and we'll take it down.
dmca.sendBody: We handle requests through tickets on our Discord server, so someone from staff can talk to you directly. Open a ticket and include:
dmca.need1: A link to each chart on UntitledCharts you want removed.
dmca.need2: What you own (the song, the artwork, or the chart itself) and where the original can be found.
dmca.need3: Your name and a way to reach you. Discord is fine, email works too.
dmca.need4: A statement that you believe in good faith the upload isn't authorized by you, your agent, or the law.
dmca.need5: A statement that the information in your request is accurate and, under penalty of perjury, that you own the rights or are allowed to act for whoever does.
dmca.need6: Your signature. Typing your full name counts.
dmca.ticketCardBody: Join the server, go to #tickets and create one. Tickets are private: only you and staff can see them.
dmca.ticketGuide: Show me how to open a ticket
dmca.ticketStep2: Go to #tickets, open a new ticket and paste your request in.
dmca.afterBody1: Someone from staff reads every ticket. If anything is missing we'll ask for it before doing anything else.
dmca.afterBody2: If the request checks out, we remove the chart, or just the file that's the problem like the audio or the cover, and tell the uploader why it was taken down.
dmca.counterTitle: If your chart was taken down
dmca.counterBody: If you think we removed your chart by mistake, for example because you have permission to use the song, open a ticket the same way and include:
dmca.counter1: Which chart was removed: its title or the old link.
dmca.counter2: Why you think it was a mistake, plus any proof of permission you have.
dmca.counter3: A statement, under penalty of perjury, that you believe in good faith the chart was removed by mistake or misidentification.
dmca.counter4: Your name, address and phone number, and a statement that you accept the jurisdiction of the courts where you live and will accept legal papers from whoever made the original request.
dmca.counter5: Your signature. Typing your full name counts.
dmca.counterAfter: We pass counter notices on to whoever made the original request. If they don't tell us within 10 to 14 business days that they've started legal action, we can put the chart back up.
dmca.repeatBody: Re-uploading something that was taken down, or racking up several valid takedowns, can get your account banned.
dmca.misuseBody1: Fake or bad-faith takedown requests get you a one-week timeout on the Discord server.
dmca.misuseBody2: Knowingly lying in a takedown or counter notice can also make you legally liable under 17 U.S.C. § 512(f), so only send one if you're sure.
dmca.footnote: We're a small team running a fan project, not lawyers, so nothing here is legal advice. If you're unsure about your rights, ask someone who is.

uploadPolicy.title: Upload Policy
uploadPolicy.subtitle: Please read the following rules before uploading your charts.
uploadPolicy.rule1: No slurs, racism, politics, heavily inappropriate things, advertising, etc.
uploadPolicy.rule2: No super-low quality shitposts (we allow some shitposts)
uploadPolicy.rule3: No public Arcaea or Taiko no Tatsujin songs
uploadPolicy.rule4: Do not abuse our services for the sake of abusing them
uploadPolicy.rule5: No official charts with minor modifications (All Flicks or All Traces are allowed occasionally only)
uploadPolicy.rule8: Your metadata must be correct (including jackets)
uploadPolicy.relaxedNote: Rules 2, 3, 5, 7, and 8 can be ignored if Unlisted.
uploadPolicy.fileSizeDesc: If your charts are larger than the upload limit, you can request support to help! We don't want to limit actual charts; so we will help you upload it!
uploadPolicy.shitpostWarning: Shitposts are not allowed for this exception. Please reconsider your life choices if you're uploading shitposts larger than the file limits.
uploadPolicy.fileTypesNote: Note: Extreme extended features can only be found in LevelData! You can open .usc in the editor to continue working.
